name: CASIVIBOT
summary:
Source: https://humanoid.guide/product/casivibot/

CASIVIBOT is a compact humanoid service robot designed for smooth interaction, reliable support tasks, and safe operation in indoor environments. It offers dual-arm manipulation, smart vision, and flexible mobility for research, healthcare, and commercial use.
